issues.title: Path check allows reading other users' files
issues.explanation: The containment check is against UPLOAD_ROOT, not the user's own folder. Express decodes params, so a request for ..%2Fbob%2Ftax.pdf arrives as ../bob/tax.pdf, stays inside uploads/ and reads bob's file. The extra decodeURIComponent is a second decode on top of that. startsWith without a trailing separator also accepts sibling folders like uploads-old. A stray % in a filename makes decodeURIComponent throw a 500.
issues.fix: Drop the second decode, resolve against path.join(UPLOAD_ROOT, userId) and require the result to start with that folder plus path.sep.

issues.title: Stream errors are unhandled
issues.explanation: existsSync is true for directories, and a file can vanish between the check and the read. createReadStream then emits an error with no listener, which crashes the process instead of returning 404.
issues.fix: Use fs.promises.stat to require a regular file, and handle the stream's error event (or use stream.pipeline).

issues.title: Filename is not escaped in Content-Disposition
issues.explanation: A name containing a quote breaks the header value, and non-ASCII names are sent raw.
issues.fix: Use res.attachment(name) or encode with filename*=UTF-8''.
